_note: String table for scripts/scaffold-project-skill.ps1. The .ps1 source is deliberately kept ASCII-only: Windows PowerShell 5.1 decodes BOM-less script files with the ANSI code page, so literal CJK inside the script would corrupt on machines with a non-UTF-8 locale. Keep new user-facing phrases here; do not inline CJK into the .ps1.
_noneWordsNote: Compared after trimming whitespace, surrounding quotes and trailing punctuation. Add variants here rather than in code.
_tailPunctuationNote: Unicode code points in decimal (JSON has no hex literals). Stripped from the END of an answer before the none-test only; the raw answer is what gets injected.

publish.section:
## 发布

执行前预览环境与命令，确认后再跑脚本。细则：`references/publish.md`。
publish.docIntro: 执行前预览环境与命令，用户确认后再跑脚本。`-Confirm` 只是防误跑，不是用户授权。
publish.otherSection:
## 其它环境

仓库级（不按项目分）：目标清单在 `.runtime/publish-targets.json`。

策略：%CMD%

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\.agents\skills\<skill>\scripts\Publish-Env.ps1 -Confirm -EnvName <名>
```

该脚本骨架默认 throw，补全真实步骤后再用。

verify.section:
## 验证

构建 / 测试 / 静态检查统一走 `scripts/Invoke-Verify.ps1`，细则：`references/verify.md`。
verify.filterHint: 单测：命令里用 `%FILTER%` 标出插入点（把参数一起写进去），例如 `dotnet test %FILTER%`；然后 `-Filter "--filter OrderTests"`。不传 `-Filter` 时占位符替换为空，即跑全量。

## 状态与日志

`scripts/Show-ProjectStatus.ps1` 汇总每个项目：在不在跑、PID、启动时间、URL、日志路径；没跑起来（或刚崩）的项目会打印日志尾部。`-IncludeLogs` 连正在跑的也打。
